title: Muon-detected Big Void to be excavated in 2026 with Ministry approval

tellings.quote: the position of the big void that they're actually going to be excavating into the Great Pyramid in 2026 to investigate the big void.

plain: A researcher named Jeffrey, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, talks about the "Big Void": a large empty space inside the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt. It was found by the ScanPyramids team, a group that looks inside pyramids using muons, tiny particles from space that pass through stone. Jeffrey says that in 2026, with approval from Egypt's Ministry of Antiquities, the government office in charge of ancient sites, workers will dig into the pyramid to investigate the void, which could reveal what the space was built for.
